slides.title: QM9
text: “Small” scale dataset with ~134,000 stable organic molecules (up to 9
heavy atoms) and 19 computed quantum properties per molecule.
• Widely used to train and benchmark ML models on molecular property prediction.
• All target properties are invariant under rotations and translations of the molecule.

slides.title: Mptraj
text: Contains ~1,580,000 3D crystal structures drawn from materials project.
• This dataset spans 89 chemical elements in all kinds of inorganic compounds.
Means an ML model sees examples of many bonding environments.
• A “universal” dataset used to train GNN potentials that aim to work for any material.

slides.title: Alexandria
text: An open-access repository of millions of quantum chemistry calculations
• Uniquely, Alexandria also stores information from the relaxation process –
i.e. slightly off-equilibrium structures and the forces on atoms as the structure relaxes.
• Not only final stable geometries, but also the paths the atoms take to get there.

slides.title: DiffDock: Predict Protein-Ligand Conformation
text: Task: Predict 3D structure of a small molecule binding to a protein.
• Rigid docking; assumes that the protein structure does not change.
• Key idea: Any ligand pose consistent with a seed conformation can be reached by a combination
of (1) ligand translations, (2) ligand rotations, and (3) changes to torsion angles.

slides.title: DiffCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction
text: A diffusion model to generate crystal structure from compositions.

slides.title: DiffCSP++: Space Group Constraints
text: Allows explicit conditioning on space group symmetry.
• First sample a lattice, then assign atoms to Wyckoff positions
(including which Wyckoff sites are occupied and by what element).
• Then sample any displacements within those sites (constrained by symmetry).

slides.title: SymmCD – Symmetry-Preserving Diffusion
